note: Estimates for actors that the World Bank snapshot omits or leaves incomplete. Every value here is an approximate estimate from public statistical offices, the IMF, the CIA World Factbook, the Bank of Korea and the Taiwan DGBAS as of 2024-2025. They are not authoritative. Fields left out keep the World Bank value. usd_rate_like copies another actor's exchange rate for a pegged currency.
